_what: The two facts about each code repository that `.agent-org/project.json` does not hold, keyed by `repo` (#3123, ADR 0039 item 5). `.agent-org/project.json`'s `code` array is THE list of code repositories and the `agent-org` tool owns its schema, so this file adds a default branch and a required check name beside it and never a second list: `layer-repository-protection.test.ts` fails when a listed repository has no entry here.
_read: `branch-protection.test.ts` takes its repository and branch from here (`A11Y_PROTECTION_REPO=<owner/name>`, else the primary's), `layer-repository-protection.test.ts` reads every entry, and `nightly.yml` runs the read once per listed repository. A repository that is declared but unreadable is CANNOT_TELL and never a pass. The order a new one is created in is `docs/new-code-repository.md`.
_requiredCheck: `gate` on both: `ci.yml`'s single job that every path-scoped result rolls up into (a required check with no run blocks a merge for ever), and the context `a11ign/agent-org`'s own ruleset requires.
